summary: incremental persistence landed: State::take_dirty returns Delta (per-primitive), lease renewals no longer dirty, Persister::spawn background writer with flush/sync/stop replaces Persister::new/persist; ADR-0010

from: CallToolResult::structured(outcome): JSON duplicated as text; raw schemars schemas (10.4k chars / 17 tools)
to: finish(): summary(&outcome) as the single text block; ServerHandler::list_tools post-processes with slim_schema (6.05k chars / 20 tools)

from: NewMemory { title, kind, body, paths, tags, permalink } constructed with every field listed at src/server.rs ~1082
to: NewMemory { title, kind, body, paths, tags, permalink, if_updated_at: Option<DateTime<Utc>> }, with the server.rs literal ending `..NewMemory::default()` so later fields are additive

summary: contract Persistence seam for primitives updated to v3 (was v2)
list tools are paged and compact; renew/status/claims_list shapes changed; id inputs accept unique prefixes; mutating results carry persist_error on write failure; status carries load_errors
from: claims_list/task_list/contract_list/notice_list/decision_list returned {count, rows} unbounded, full ids, null fields; renew returned {claims}; status always returned agents with full paths; NoticeId::parse/TaskId::parse on inputs
to: lists: inputs limit (default 20, max 200) and before (RFC 3339 or next_before); outputs {count, total, truncated, next_before?, rows} newest first, rows compact (no nulls/empty arrays, 8-char ids, second timestamps, no acked_by); claims_list: mine + overlapping path by default, all=true for the board; notice_list unread without path scopes to held paths (all=true to widen; message when nothing held); renew: {count, expires_at}; status: counts + agents_active + memory + persist_error + load_errors, agents only with verbose=true (max 50 rows of paths_count); notice_ack/task_update/depends_on resolve prefixes via State::resolve_notice/resolve_task; finish() adds persist_error and a "warning: not persisted" text line when flush fails; TOOL_LIST_LIMIT 6144 -> 6656

summary: claims.rs (ADR-0015): Claim::renew is now bounded by Claim::max_expiry (4 TTLs, max 4 h from claimed_at); new Claim::reassert restarts the age; ClaimBook::renew reasserts; Granted gained absorbed_paths (serde default, skipped when empty); new Reaped/LostLease types; ttl clamped on load
from: Claim::renew(now) always extended to now + ttl; ClaimBook::renew called touch; Granted { claim_id, new_paths, renewed_paths, expires_at }
to: Claim::renew(now) = min(now + ttl, max_expiry()); Claim::reassert(now); ClaimBook::renew reasserts; Granted { .., absorbed_paths: Vec<RepoPath>, .. }; Reaped { record(&[Claim], now), take_for(&AgentId) -> Vec<LostLease>, previous_owner(&RepoPath) -> Option<&LostLease>, is_empty() }; LostLease { path, owner, at }; consts MAX_LEASE_AGE_FACTOR=4, MAX_LEASE_AGE_SECS=14400

summary: Tasks/contracts audit: TaskBoard::update and State::task_update take force: bool; TaskBoard::reap_orphans + State per-agent last_seen reap in_progress tasks of silent owners (default 1800 s, set_task_orphan_secs, serve --task-orphan-secs); StatusReport.tasks_orphaned; NewContract.consumers is Option<Vec<RepoPath>> (None keeps existing) + expected_version: Option<u32>; Published.notify is the old+new consumer union the contract notice goes to; new TaskError::OwnedByOther and ContractError::VersionConflict map to status conflict; tool inputs task_update.force and contract_publish.expected_version.
from: update(agent, id, status, note, now); NewContract { consumers: Vec<RepoPath>, .. }; any agent could take/close another's in_progress task; republish without consumers wiped them
to: update(agent, id, status, note, force, now); NewContract { consumers: Option<Vec<RepoPath>>, expected_version: Option<u32>, .. }; conflict {owner, since} unless force; conflict {current_version, published_by} on stale expected_version

summary: Daemon shutdown no longer waits for idle SSE streams: ServerHandle::shutdown signals graceful shutdown, waits at most SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE (2 s), aborts the server task, then syncs the persister and removes daemon.json only when it still records this process's pid. `tirith serve` also stops on SIGTERM and when its repository root disappears (checked every 2 s). The shim's restart path can rely on the old pid exiting within ~3 s of SIGINT.
from: shutdown waited for every open connection; daemon.json removed unconditionally; serve stopped only on ctrl-c
to: 2 s deadline then abort; daemon.json removed only if pid matches; serve stops on ctrl-c, SIGTERM, or a vanished root
